inventory.preview: Human Capital: On December 31, 2025, the Company employed approximately 60,500 people (full-time equivalents), with approximately 22,500 employed in the United

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: States and 38,000 employed internationally. The ability to recruit, retain, develop, protect, and fairly compensate its global workforce are enablers of 3M’s success. This

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: includes five general categories of focus: Health and Safety; Performance Culture; Development; People and Community; and Compensation and Benefits.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Health and Safety:

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: 3M is committed to the safety, health, and well-being of its employees. The Company continuously evaluates opportunities to raise safety and health standards, training site

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: leaders and conducting site visits to identify and manage environmental health and safety risks; evaluating compliance with regulatory requirements and 3M policy; and

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: prevention programs, on-site clinical services, employee assistance programs, and comprehensive health care benefits.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Performance Culture:

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: 3M’s performance culture is grounded in five behavioral expectations that apply consistently across all levels of the organization: Deliver Results, Challenge the Status

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Quo, Instill Rigor and Accountability, Energize the Team to Act, and Act Responsibly and Respectfully. These behaviors guide how the Company evaluates, rewards,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: recognizes and develops its people to support a high-performance environment. Through clear communications to candidates and employees, these expectations serve as a

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: foundation for how work gets done at 3M. Development programs for executive leaders, people leaders, and individual contributors are aligned to help ensure employees

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: have the capabilities needed to demonstrate them effectively. 3M’s performance enablement process emphasizes clear goal setting, regular coaching, and feedback, and

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: differentiated performance rewards to reinforce the Company’s “pay for performance” approach.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Development:

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Developing employees contributes to growing 3M’s business. 3M maintains talent and succession planning processes, including regular reviews by the Company’s chief

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: executive officer (CEO) and reporting up through the Board of Directors. The Company provides leadership development experiences through enterprise leadership

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: development programs, job-based or project-based assignments, assessment and coaching, and targeted skill-development where leaders are given the opportunity to learn,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: apply, and share their skills. 3M also provides opportunities for all employees to learn, in addition to regular coaching and support from their supervisor. With the

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: aspirations and advance their skills.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: 3M is committed to developing a skilled, engaged, and innovative workforce and to strengthening the communities in which it operates. The Company supports its people

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: through talent practices that attract, develop, and retain employees with a wide variety of expertise and experiences, and fosters a work environment that promotes

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: becomes aware of certain writs of summons, pre-suit claims, demands or other preliminary or informal assertions of claims or potential future claims that may proceed in the

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: United States or in foreign countries. In response, the Company or its subsidiaries may engage in respect of such matters where it believes it would be appropriate to work

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: towards a negotiated resolution of such matters. Any determination that the Company’s operations or activities are not, or were not, in compliance with applicable laws or

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.preview: Process for Disclosure and Recording of Liabilities Related to Legal Proceedings: Many lawsuits and claims involve highly complex issues relating to causation, scientific

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: evidence, and alleged actual damages, all of which are subject to substantial uncertainties. Assessments of lawsuits and claims can involve a series of complex judgments about

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: future events and can rely heavily on estimates and assumptions. The categories of legal proceedings in which the Company is involved may include multiple lawsuits and

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: claims, may be spread across multiple jurisdictions and courts which may handle the lawsuits and claims differently, may involve numerous and different types of plaintiffs,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: raising claims and legal theories based on specific allegations that may not apply to other matters, and may seek substantial compensatory and, in some cases, punitive,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: damages. These and other factors contribute to the complexity of these lawsuits and claims and make it difficult for the Company to predict outcomes and make reasonable

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: estimates of any resulting losses. The Company's ability to predict outcomes and make reasonable estimates of potential losses is further influenced by the fact that a resolution

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: of one or more matters within a category of legal proceedings may impact the resolution of other matters in that category in terms of timing, amount of liability, or both.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: guidance, and records liabilities in those instances where it can reasonably estimate the amount of the loss and when the loss is probable. Where the reasonable estimate of the

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: estimate. The Company either discloses the amount of a possible loss or range of loss in excess of established accruals if estimable, or states that such an estimate cannot be

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Securities Trading and Insider Information Policy

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Applies To

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: This Policy applies to members of 3M's Board of Directors, all 3M and subsidiary employees and those acting on behalf of 3M or its subsidiaries, including consultants and

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: contract workers, and 3M itself (collectively, "Covered Persons").

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Introduction & Background or Purpose

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: During their activities with 3M, Covered Persons may become aware of information about 3M or other companies that has not been made public. The use of such non-public or

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: “inside” information about 3M or the other company in violation of 3M policy may also be a violation of the laws of many countries where 3M does business. Such laws make

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: it unlawful for any person who has “material” non-public information about a company to trade the stock or other securities of that company or to disclose such information to

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: others who may trade.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Insider trading is illegal and is prohibited. Covered Persons must (1) comply with all securities and insider trading laws, and (2) not disclose material, non-public information,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: or, while knowing material non-public information about 3M or another company, purchase or sell securities (e.g., stock, options, puts, calls, or any other derivatives) of 3M or

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: the other company. In addition, senior 3M executives must comply with Securities and Exchange Commission rules restricting their ability to trade in 3M securities.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Requirements

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Overall responsibility for ensuring compliance with these requirements is assigned to the 3M Legal Affairs organization.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Material, non-public information is information that is not available to the general public and that could influence an investor to buy, sell, or hold securities. Any information,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: whether positive or negative, that may affect the stock price (either up or down) should be regarded as material.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Examples include unannounced:

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Company or business unit financial results,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Earnings per share, including confirmation of previously issued earnings guidance,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Dividend actions or other changes to the capital structure, including share repurchases,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or joint ventures,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Major litigation or government investigations,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Major management changes,

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Cybersecurity incidents, data security breaches, and other disruptions to 3M’s information

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • technology infrastructure, and

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • Significant new product development or advances in research

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: It may not be clear whether certain information is “material,” so always seek the advice of the appropriate member of the Legal Affairs department if you are uncertain. Please

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: note that the importance of information to an investor will be viewed after the fact by government regulators, prosecutors, courts and others with the benefit of 20/20 hindsight.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Information is non-public until it has been disclosed to the investing public through established news services, such as Dow Jones News Services, and sufficient time has passed

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: to allow the information to be disseminated through the trading markets, typically upon completion of one full trading day after public disclosure. For example, if information is

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: disclosed before the market opens on a Tuesday, it would be considered broadly disseminated by the open of regular trading on Wednesday.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Insider trading is illegal and is prohibited by 3M policy. Covered Persons must follow these requirements:

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • You must not buy or sell stock or other securities of 3M, directly or indirectly through family members or other persons or entities, while you are in possession of

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: material, non-public information concerning 3M.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • You must not buy or sell stock or other securities of any other company (including, for example, a current or prospective 3M customer, supplier, or counterparty to a

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: potential corporate development transaction), directly or indirectly through family members or other persons or entities, while you are in possession of material, non-

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: public information concerning the company. Please note that information that is not material to 3M may be material to the other company.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • You must not disclose material, non-public information about any company to any other person, including family members, friends, or colleagues, where the

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: information may be used by the other person to transact in the company’s securities, even if you will not financially benefit from it.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • You must not recommend or suggest that anyone else buy, sell, or retain the stock or other securities of any company while you have material, non-public information

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: about the company.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • You must not provide access to material, non-public information when it does not meet the strict need-to-know requirement.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • As general guidance, anyone with access to company-wide financial data (sales and/or costs) should not trade securities from the 15th of the last month of a quarter

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: until completion of one full trading day after issuance of the quarterly earnings press release.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: • In addition, from time to time 3M may notify you of specific periods when you are prohibited from buying or selling stock or other securities of 3M or another

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: company.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Certain trading features, such as standing or market limit orders (e.g., an order to exercise a stock option or sell stock when it reaches a specified price), holding shares in a

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: margin account, and pledging shares as collateral for a loan carry heightened risks for insider trading violations because you have no control over the timing of a transaction

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: which could be executed by a broker with your standing instructions while you are in possession of material, non-public information.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: It is the ultimate responsibility of each Covered Person to comply with insider trading rules. Failure to comply with the requirements of the law and this Policy could lead to: (i)

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: criminal and civil penalties for 3M and any individual involved in the violation, (ii) discipline, up to and including termination of employment, (iii) significant business

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: disruptions, and (iv) harm to 3M’s reputation.

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: Section 16 officers (those senior executives who are members of the Corporate Operations Committee and the Chief Accounting Officer) and members of the 3M's Board of

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: (sales of securities that are not then owned), (ii) trading in any options, puts, calls, or other derivatives that is directly linked to 3M securities at any time, (iii) engaging in any

inventory.reason: Text passage, heading, caption or footnote
inventory.preview: type of hedging activity involving 3M securities, (iv) using standing or market limit orders, (v) holding 3M securities in a margin account, or (vi) pledging 3M securities as
